01. 1.
This matter is taken up through Hybrid mode.
2. Perused the application, it appears that on the basis of the prisoner's petition the present appeal has been registered challenging the judgment of conviction passed by the learned Adhoc Addl.

District and Sessions Judge (FTSC), Jajpur in C.T. Special (POCSO) Case No.116 of 2020 vide judgment dated 16.02.2024, thereby convicting the Appellant for commission of an offence punishable under Sections 376(3), 363, 366 of IPC and sentencing him to undergo maximum imprisonment for 20 years.
However, it appears that there exists a delay of 102 days in presenting the appeal before this Court.

3. Taking into consideration the fact that since the Appellant is languishing in custody since 04.10.2020, he could not engaged a counsel to file an appeal, this Court is inclined to condone the delay of 102 days.
Accordingly, the delay of 102 days in presenting the appeal is hereby condoned.
Office is directed to send the matter before the Orissa High Court Legal Services Committee for engagement of counsel having sufficient experience in conducting criminal appeals.
